title: Rename missing Completed output status
summary: Renames the Completed selected-summary missing-output badge from the harsh Broken proof wording to Output unavailable, while keeping non-output blocked rows as Needs review.
reason: When the output file is missing or unavailable, the operator needs a clear condition label rather than a verdict about proof quality.
behavior_before: Completed selected rows in blocked state displayed Broken proof even when the backend simply had no output file available to inspect.
behavior_after: Completed selected rows with missing, unavailable, or metadata-without-media output health display Output unavailable; other blocked rows display Needs review. Raw backend trust detail remains available in completed-detail.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke.py to assert Output unavailable and the display trust state for missing Completed output rows.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_row_detail_smoke.py to assert Output unavailable in the high-risk Completed selected summary.
